notes.title: PLANET KEEPER PROGRAM - OUR NEW GAME!
notes.notes:
[p]We're making a new game!  

It's called Planet Keeper Program.  

It's an incremental game about planetary defense. Work for the US government, destroy space threats, die a lot and improve your defenses to advance through the levels and guarantee the future of planet Earth. Yes, your work is very mysterious and important.   

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2923610/Planet_Keeper_Program/?beta=1"][/dynamiclink]  
Questions that have never been asked, but that we want to answer:    

1. Is it a parody game like Impeachment Survivors?  
No.    

2. First you made a game set in Brazil, now in the United States, do you intend to make a game for each of the 195 countries in the world?  
No.    

3. I was interested in the new game, how does it work?  
Thank you very much for asking! The game takes place inside an Area 51 computer program, it's as if you were a US military officer testing the planet's defenses against future threats!    

4. I really enjoyed it! I'll add it to my wishlist and follow the game's page.  
Do it!  [/p]
